Recent notes

  • DREAM pedestal stability — X17 at n_TOF 2026-08-15NTOFDAQPedestalsQACampaign

    Every DREAM pedestal run of the n_TOF campaign, per channel and per chip: a doubled noise floor on 23 July, chamber A's excursion, and a connector that was dead through run_79.

  • The 2026 X17 physics run at n_TOF EAR2 — end-of-run report 2026-08-15NTOFCampaignDAQMicromegasGamma flashTracking

    What was built, what the gamma flash does to the readout, what we actually measured, and what a post-LS3 measurement would need. 28 June – 10 August 2026. Analysis preliminary.

  • Anatomy of the unmatched 2.4% 2026-08-13NTOFMatchingQAFailure modes

    Every non-matched pulse since run_79, dissected by failure mode — and the outcome: 277,146 of 279,113 pulses (99.30 %) matched after the dark hours and the never-slimmed hours were recovered on 15 Aug; the dark hours were a top-8 candidate cap, not missing data.

  • Beam tracks image the He-3 target (run_145, arm A) 2026-08-13NTOFTrackingImagingCampaign

    First waveform-first tracking on a fully nTOF-matched beam run: arm A back-projects to a source at the origin, and the image sharpness gives an in-situ drift velocity. Full coverage incl. the head-on band; all four arms shown.

  • DREAM↔n_TOF matching: an outside audit 2026-08-13NTOFMatchingQAAudit

    The physics is solved — 96% vs 0.05% per-pulse separation — but the pipeline lets weak instruments decide and rebuilds the decisive one four times. Critique, simplification plan, and the per-pulse ledger design.

  • June fleet rerun: the v1 recipe bug, fixed on the grid 2026-08-13Cosmic benchMicromegasWaveformsCampaign

    184 of 214 campaign rows ran an effectively chi2-only recipe on lxplus; every job now carries a locally-computed matched list. 156 grid jobs, tier B unblocked, 21 rows promoted.
